title: 归档会话 → 在已归档视图里找到它
description: 把一个真实会话归档：主列表应移除它，数据库 archived_at 写入；点侧边栏的「已归档的会话」后，它应出现在归档视图里。
preconditions: 应用已启动；至少一个活跃会话。
expectations: 归档后活跃列表不再显示该会话
数据库 archived_at 非空且 status=archived
归档视图列出该会话，并明确标注「已归档」

db.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND archived_at IS NULL AND title NOT IN (SELECT name FROM workspaces) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1
SELECT (archived_at IS NOT NULL AND status = 'archived') AS ok FROM threads WHERE title = '{{target}}' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

assert.message: 归档后活跃列表不再有该会话行
